facts.claim: Disney Magic (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 1998; 83,333 GT; 2400 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Magic class.
Disney Magic is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the first ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the lead vessel of the Magic class.
The ship was followed by her sister ship, Disney Wonder (1999).

catalogSpecs.description: Magic-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 1998; 83,333 GT; approx. 2,400 guests at double occupancy.
